## How it was tested / Cómo se probó

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` (after `npm run build`)
- [ ] `npm run validate:plugin` / `npm run test:plugin` (if the mod changed)

## Checklist

- [ ] UI texts are in both `electron/locales/es.ts` and `en.ts` (Spanish with *tú*) / Los textos están en los dos idiomas.
- [ ] Comments in English / Comentarios en inglés.
- [ ] Snapshot changes follow the `schemaVersion` policy in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` (if any).
- [ ] No new network calls or telemetry.
- [ ] Screenshot or clip for visible changes (a demo scene works well).
- [ ] **No transcripts, snapshots, logs or personal paths pasted here or committed in fixtures.** / **Sin transcripciones ni rutas personales.**
